title: Inca Grass Bridges Over 200-Foot Canyons
hook: Inca engineers wove bridges across raging rivers out of wild grass fibers.

scenes.text: Across the Andes mountain range, deep roaring river canyons presented seemingly impassable barriers to Inca army expansion.
